key_findings: Dual sEH/HDAC6 inhibitor M9 (IC50 2 nM sEH, 5 nM HDAC6) is selective for HDAC6 over class I HDACs
M9 relieved SNI neuropathic pain without the tolerance seen with gabapentin and improved survival in LPS-treated mice
